title: Prove project.crash optimality exactly, from the original project, instead of from the LP's floating-point gap
problem: certify_crash compared a plan's cost only with the LP objective at the engine's own point, and that point passes linear.certify_lp, whose gap tolerance is relative 1e-7 x (1 + |primal|). With absolute start and finish times, the tolerance at 1e8 durations is tens of cost units, so a suboptimal vertex was certified as the cheapest plan (#217).
founder_intent_refs: INTENT-20261013-FRONTIER-LEAP-RECOMBINE (every constructed answer re-proved in the original problem's terms)
founder directive 2026-10-28 (TRUE ABSOLUTE OPUS MAXIMUS), this session
baseline: #196 at 917404cf: the issue's two suboptimal points certified (costs 30 and 18 against the optimum 15); probe with HiGHS's real prices calls 5/387, 242/355 and 345/345 suboptimal plans cheapest at durations +1e6, +1e7 and +1e8.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: Route A: read the engine's certified LP prices back as a flow from the project's start to its deadline, and compute Fulkerson's lower bound from it in exact integers inside certify_crash; drop the two implied variable bounds from encode_crash so every dual is such a flow.
advantages: Only greg/recombine.py changes; linear.py and its 17 frozen bindings are untouched.
Optimality is re-proved per call from the original project, like the staffing, matching and selection certificates.
disadvantages: crash-via-lp's source digest changes, so formed project.crash constructions quarantine and re-qualify.
Recorded crash answers without a flow cannot be re-certified by the new certifier.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: Route B: tighten or rescale the gap tolerance in linear.certify_lp for every LP.
advantages: Fixes the tolerance for every LP, not only crash.
disadvantages: linear.py is bound at its current digest by 17 frozen records; every LP-based admitted verdict would need pre-registered re-admission.
A floating-point tolerance can only be narrowed, never made exact, for an engine that works in floating point.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Another LP consumer shown to certify a wrong optimum at scale; then a pre-registered re-admission plan for the 17 bindings.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Route C: detection only, refusing a certificate whose absolute gap is large in the crash's own cost scale.
advantages: Cheap; no binding changes outside recombine.py.
disadvantages: Not sound: approximate stationarity times large bounds still loosens the bound.
alternatives.revival_evidence: None; kept as the rejected cheaper option.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: GREG keeps certifying some suboptimal crash plans as cheapest on large-duration projects.
disadvantages: A construction's certificate exists so that GREG never trusts its engine; this one did.

roles.position: An answer GREG calls proved must be proved; the destination of constructed capabilities is certified answers in the founder's own terms. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: Do not let the fix narrow the function (durations, sizes) or hide refusals.

roles.position: Keep the proof inside the reduction that owns it; leave the shared LP certificate and its frozen bindings alone. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: Rounded floating-point prices must never be trusted: the flow is checked, not believed.

roles.position: Attack the bound: forged flows, negative or fractional units, non-precedence arcs, broken conservation, a dropped deadline term, an engine's objective that lies. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: A bound above the true optimum would certify an overpriced plan; weak duality must hold for every flow the checker accepts.

roles.position: Availability must not drop: both real engines' prices must round to exact certificates. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: GLOP places price on implied bounds for zero-duration tasks; the encoding must not offer them.

roles.position: A founder deciding by a 'cheapest plan' must not be shown an overpriced one as proved; recorded answers certified by the old certificate keep their old label and are not silently re-labelled. All five roles performed by one agent; not independent review.
material_concerns: Old recorded crash answers cannot be re-certified without a flow; say so where they are consumed (#213).

evidence.claim: The issue's suboptimal points are certified before and refused after
evidence.finding: Before: costs 15, 30 and 18 certified. After: only 15.

evidence.claim: With real engine prices, suboptimal plans are no longer called cheapest at any scale
evidence.finding: Before 0, 0, 5, 242, 345 false optima at offsets 1, 1e4, 1e6, 1e7, 1e8; after 0 at every offset; neither refused an optimum.

evidence.claim: Qualification is unchanged on both engines
evidence.finding: 416 engine cases each on HiGHS and GLOP, 0 wrong, 0 refused.

counterevidence.claim: Rounding the engine's prices always yields a certificate
counterevidence.reference: first engine run during development (GLOP, zero-duration tasks)
counterevidence.finding: False with the old encoding: GLOP priced the implied bounds start <= deadline and finish >= 0, which the flow cannot express (3 of 34 at small scale). Fixed by dropping those implied bounds from the encoding.
False at 1e8: GLOP's floating-point plan can finish a task one unit short, which the exact plan check refuses, as it did before this change.

pass_1.intended_outcome: project.crash calls a plan the cheapest only when GREG has proved, in exact integers from the original project, that no on-time plan costs less.

advantages.statement: The certificate is a flow a person can read: how much each unit of deadline is worth along which tasks.
advantages.amplified_value: Certificate transport, as the other constructions do; the bound is the time-cost trade-off's marginal price of the deadline.

advantages.statement: No tolerance anywhere in the optimality proof.
advantages.amplified_value: Correct at every scale the engine accepts, independent of the engine's floating point.

disadvantages.statement: Engine prices are floating point and might not round to an exact flow.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: The constraint matrix is a network matrix with integer costs, so optimal duals are integral; measured on both engines at three scales and on the 60-seed qualification.

disadvantages.statement: Formed project.crash constructions quarantine on the digest change.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: This is the designed response to a reduction-code change; they re-qualify through the frozen oracle.

disadvantages.statement: Recorded crash answers from before the change carry no flow.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Disclosed; their consumers (#213's recertify) re-certify with the certifier they were recorded under or a freshly computed flow.

comparisons.baseline: Suboptimal plans certified at large durations.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Route B would unbind 17 frozen records and still rest on a tolerance.

rejected_alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Unbinds 17 frozen records for a defect local to one reduction; still tolerance-based.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Another LP consumer shown to certify a wrong optimum at scale.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack the strengthened design: forged and malformed flows, weak duality, the encoding change, engine degeneracy, scale, consumers of recorded answers, and the claim of no availability loss.

new_weaknesses.statement: A forged flow could claim a bound above the true optimum.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Weak duality holds for every nonnegative integer conserved flow on precedence arcs; property-tested against exhaustive enumeration (over 1,000 flows) and mutant-tested.

new_weaknesses.statement: Dropping the implied bounds could change the program's feasible set or make it unbounded.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Both bounds are implied by the duration rows (finish >= start + shortest >= 0; start <= finish - shortest <= deadline); the objective is bounded below by -sum c d; qualification unchanged.

new_weaknesses.statement: A future engine might return a fractional (non-vertex) optimal dual.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Then the rounded flow fails its own check and the answer is refused: an availability loss, never a false proof. Recorded as a limit.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Measured: no flow-certificate refusal on either engine across the qualification and the scale tests.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: A new LP engine candidate, or a refusal by the flow certificate in service.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Disclosed in the evidence README and the PR; the #213 adaptation is offered to whichever PR is joined second.

pass_2.final_design: Route A in greg/recombine.py only: _deadline_flow in decode, _deadline_bound in certify, encode without the two implied bounds; six new mutants; linear.py untouched.

residual_risks.risk: GLOP's floating-point plan at 1e8 can miss a bound by a unit and is refused.
residual_risks.mitigation: Unchanged from before; the exact plan check refuses it and the construction's engine fault path applies.

residual_risks.risk: Synthetic projects only; no founder project was run.

entries.position: linear.certify_lp's relative tolerance is still loose at large magnitudes for any other LP consumer.
entries.rationale: Route A fixes the crash construction, which re-proves its own optimality; lp.optimize answers used directly keep the engine-level tolerance.
entries.evidence_threshold: A consumer of lp.optimize shown to rely on its optimum at a scale where the tolerance exceeds the decision-relevant difference.
entries.review_trigger: Next LP admission or a consumer audit.

migration_plan: Draft child of #196; the integrator decides intake. Formed project.crash constructions quarantine and re-qualify; recorded answers stay as recorded.

steps: Revert this PR's commit; the old certificate and its evidence return; nothing else changes.

kill_criteria: A legitimate engine optimum is refused by the flow certificate.
A suboptimal on-time plan is certified as cheapest.
